Players Committee card image of [[Anakin Skywalker, Padawan Learner (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E3), game text: “Adds 3 to the power of anything he pilots. Deploys -2 aboard Azure Angel. Adds 2 to maneuver of anything he pilots. Players may initiate battles here for free. During battle, your battle destiny draws and Anakin's weapon destiny draws are +1. Immune to attrition < 4.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/anakinskywalkerpadawanlearner_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 e8445f0] (1 June 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.
